subject: Re: Pilot extension + one-off credit to hit EOY close
messages:
From: Lydia Park <lydia@novusai.com>
To: karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com
Cc: ben.carter@redwoodinference.com, lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sun, 27 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Need a small extension + credit to finish PoC this week

Hi Karthik —

Quick note from my side: we hit a blocker in the sentiment evaluation step and our data infra team needs until Friday to validate the ingestion pipeline. We really want to finish the PoC this week so we can present to the execs next Tuesday (Q3 planning calendar).

Two asks: can we get a one-week trial extension (so tokens don't cut off mid-demo) and a small consumption credit to cover the extra runs? If we can show production-like throughput during the exec demo, this pulls the contract forward.

Happy to sign a short addendum or accept a one-off invoice credit — whatever's faster.

Thanks — Lydia
Lydia Park
Director of ML Ops, Novus AI
lydia@novusai.com
+1 415-555-0199
From: karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com
To: Lydia Park <lydia@novusai.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwoodinference.com, lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Need a small extension + credit to finish PoC this week

Hi Lydia — thanks for the heads up and congrats on reaching the exec demo milestone. Totally get the timeline urgency.

Short answer: we can do a one-week trial extension and a one-off credit to cover the extra runs. I need a quick internal sign-off on exact token allowance but can commit to a credit in the neighborhood of $2,000 (applied as platform credit against usage) and an extension through 2027-07-07.

Can you confirm the expected token burn (approx) for the final validation runs and whether you need any additional model variants enabled for the demo? I’ll loop back with formal approval and a stubbed credit note you can share with your finance team.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com
From: karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com
To: ben.carter@redwoodinference.com, lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: INTERNAL: quick approval request — Novus PoC extension + $2k credit

Ben / Lauren — Lydia at Novus asked for a one-week extension (through 2027-07-07) and a $2,000 consumption credit to finish the PoC and present to execs next week. Pipeline motion looks solid; they asked to accelerate the proof so they can decide before their procurement blackout on 2027-07-15.

Why I recommend approving:
- ARR motion: forecasted ~75k ARR in 12 months post-pilot
- Competitive risk: they’re also testing two other vendors for latency and cost; small credit moves the show window to our favor
- One-off, non-recurring credit, credit routed to platform balance — no change to pricing or SLAs

Request: approved? If yes I’ll send Lydia formal note and attach the stub PDF for their records.

Thanks,
Karthik

On Tue, Jun 29, 2027 at 09:15 AM lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com wrote:
> +1 from my side for $2k one-off. Recommend attaching the PoC acceptance criteria (scope v2) so they can sign fast.
>
> — Lauren
From: karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com
To: Lydia Park <lydia@novusai.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwoodinference.com, lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Approved: one-week extension + $2,000 credit (Novus AI PoC)

Hi Lydia — great news: we've approved a one-week trial extension through 2027-07-07 and a one-time $2,000 usage credit applied to your account.

What we did:
- Extended the pilot window so your tokens won't cut off during the exec demo
- Applied a $2,000 platform credit to your account (one-off, non-recurring) — you’ll see it as a credit line on the billing page
- Attached: redwood-credit-approval-stub.pdf (internal approval summary) and an updated PoC scope (novus-poc-scope-v2.docx) with acceptance criteria for the demo.

Next steps for Novus:
- Please confirm the expected token burn for the final validation runs (estimate in tokens or dollars).
- If finance needs a signed addendum, let us know and I can route a DocuSign. If not, this credit will be reflected on your billing dashboard within 2 business days.

DocuSign (optional): https://www.docusign.com/sign/ABC123xyz
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/NDL-7821

Good luck with the exec presentation — ping me if you need an on-call infra hand during the demo.

Cheers,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood-credit-approval-stub.pdf (pdf), novus-poc-scope-v2.docx (docx)
